_note: Curated corrections to the `knowledge` and `mechanics` blocks of ability_formulas.json. Those blocks are LLM-estimated during extraction, and a re-extraction would regenerate the same errors, so corrections live here and are folded in by every loader (web/advisor/profiles.py, web/fight_engine.py, scripts/export_engine_data.py). Only add an entry when the extracted value is factually WRONG and the evidence can be stated; every entry needs a reason.

_schema.knowledge: keys merged over the champion's knowledge block (resource, asEfficiency, abilitiesCanCrit, ...)
_schema.removeMechanics: list of mechanic kinds to delete from the champion's mechanics list
_schema.reason: why the extraction is wrong here. Required.
_schema.abilities: per-slot overrides folded into the extracted ability. Supported: damage (REPLACES the slot's damage list wholesale), empowerLimit (how many following attacks one cast empowers -- read by both engines ahead of the prose heuristic), steroids (replace the slot's steroid list), and component fields such as ratios, crossRatios, baseAdd, hits, when, recastIndex, empowerLimit, and mortalWill. Requires reason quoting the source text.
_schema.mechanicUpdates: fields merged into an existing mechanic by kind; useful for rank/level-scaled passive values without replacing the whole mechanic
_schema.resolvedUnmodeled: exact tooltip notes that are now represented by structured formula fields and should no longer count as unresolved coverage gaps
_schema.addMechanics: reviewed mechanics to append when extraction omitted them; duplicate kinds are ignored

Garen.reason: Extraction says resource=mana; Garen has no resource. Base stats carry mana=null and no ability lists a cost. The error was masked by a correct noResource mechanic, but anything reading the resource field directly sees the wrong answer.

Mordekaiser.reason: Extraction says resource=mana; Mordekaiser is manaless (base mana=null, no costs). Unlike Garen he has NO noResource mechanic either, so nothing told the model mana stats are dead on him. 7.2d drift: asEfficiency 0.3 -> 0.2. The 7.2d re-extraction moved this value without the patch touching the champion's attack pattern (asEfficiency 0.3 -> asEfficiency 0.3 -> 0.2); the pre-patch value is what the current builds were judged on. Re-litigate with evidence rather than letting an unrelated patch re-tune it.

Graves.reason: Extraction says resource=none plus a noResource mechanic, and the prompt told the model Graves 'has NO mana'. He has 390 base mana and pays per cast (Q 65/70/75/80) -- wildriftfire and wr-meta agree. The reload/magazine mechanic likely got conflated with resourcelessness. RANK TIERS EXTRACTED AS SEPARATE RATIOS. A tooltip's '110 / 130 / 150 / 170% AD' is one ratio that scales with ability rank, and 63 components across the roster store it correctly as a single entry with a rank-list pct. These two were written as FOUR separate same-stat ratios instead, and the engine sums every ratio in the list, so the ability was charged 110+130+150+170 = 560% AD at every rank. On Graves that made End of the Line roughly three times its real damage and dominated his whole profile: an engine enumeration of his best damage build came back as a zero-attack-speed ability-haste build, because Q was worth more than his shotgun. Graves' PASSIVE is deliberately left alone: [72, 24, 24, 24] really is four bullets and really does add up. SHOTGUN CRIT PELLETS. The passive fires 4 bullets normally for 72% AD then 24% for each additional, and 6 on a critical strike with each bullet's damage increased by 50%. The 7.3 note 'Shotgun Critical Strike Damage rate: 1.3 -> 1.5' is that same 50%, stated as a rate; the scraped tooltip says 30%, which is the PRE-7.3 number and is still wrong on the site. So the crit line is 72x1.5 = 108 for the first bullet and 24x1.5 = 36 for each of the other five, 288% AD in total. Extraction had 130 + 30x5 = 280%, which matches neither the old rate (249.6%) nor the new one. Confirmed against the client by the owner 2026-09-25.

Camille.reason: The scraped Q text carries only the FIRST empowered attack; the recast sentence is missing, so extraction modelled one physical hit and flagged nothing unmodeled. Tencent's hero data (10055): '第一次攻击的1.6秒后，精准礼仪会自动强化下一次普通攻击，将伤害的40%转化为真实伤害' -- one cast empowers TWO attacks, the second converting 40% of its damage to true. ENCODING: the engines charge every per-auto component on every empowered attack (empowerLimit x casts), so the two unequal hits are stored as their PER-ATTACK AVERAGE -- hit1 130-160% AD physical plus hit2 60/40 phys/true averages to 104-128% physical + 26-32% true per empowered attack, exact in total with empowerLimit 2. Writing the hits separately double-counted (each comp rode both empowered attacks). Owner-approved 2026-08-20.

Patch 7.3 moved this champion's damage onto CRIT scaling and the extraction kept only the printed ratio, so crit items were priced at their stat line alone. Across the roster 45 abilities carry crit scaling in `unmodeled` with only Miss Fortune's Love Tap actually modelled, and 14 of those notes were written by 7.3 itself. P:Headshot -- 7.3: Headshot bonus damage is (60-100%) x AD + Critical Rate x 100% + (Critical Damage - 2) x Critical Rate x 100% x AD. Extraction kept only the 60% AD ratio, so the champion whose whole identity is crit gained nothing from crit items beyond the item's own stat line.

Extraction left the passive empty, which made every Miss Fortune build omit its defining crit-dependent proc. Patch 7.3 moved this champion's damage onto CRIT scaling and the extraction kept only the printed ratio, so crit items were priced at their stat line alone. Across the roster 45 abilities carry crit scaling in `unmodeled` with only Miss Fortune's Love Tap actually modelled, and 14 of those notes were written by 7.3 itself. That is a large part of why the engine ranked on-hit above crit for exactly these champions. 1:Double Up - Ricochet -- 7.3: second-hit damage ratio 120% -> 60% x current Critical Damage. At the 2.0 base that is the old 120%, so this only adds the part that grows with crit damage. 4:Bullet Time -- 7.3: critical ratio 130% -> 130% + (Critical Damage - 2) x 0.3.

Varus.reason: Each Blight stack adds 0.012 percentage points of target-max-health damage per AP. Extraction stored 0.012% AP as flat damage, erasing the multiplicative AP/max-health term and severely under-rating AP Varus.

_revertNote: Twisted Fate (asEfficiency 0.8) and Kennen (0.7) corrections were applied on 2026-07-29 and REVERTED the same day on owner meta-judgment: with the raised values the model built Nashor's Tooth as an effective core item on both (slot 2 in consecutive Twisted Fate runs), and neither champion builds it as a staple in the live meta. Their every-N-hit passives are real, but the extraction's 0.2 produces the builds that match reality. If this comes up again, re-litigate with N-run evidence against real meta builds, not from ability text alone.
